import json,sys,time,urllib.request,math
urllib.request.install_opener(urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({})))
ready_deadline=float(sys.argv[1]);request_deadline=float(sys.argv[2]);model='kimi-k2.6-sf-reference'
cases=[{'name':'arithmetic','prompt':'请计算17加25。只输出整数结果，不要解释。','expected':'42','max_tokens':128,'ignore_eos':False},{'name':'translation','prompt':'请将英文单词cat翻译成中文。只输出译文，不要解释。','expected':'猫','max_tokens':128,'ignore_eos':False},{'name':'fixed32','prompt':'用中文解释为什么天空通常呈蓝色，写一段完整且连贯的说明。','expected':None,'max_tokens':32,'ignore_eos':True}]
def make_payload(case):
 return {'model':model,'messages':[{'role':'user','content':case['prompt']}],'temperature':0,'seed':20261024,'n':1,'max_tokens':case['max_tokens'],'ignore_eos':case['ignore_eos'],'stream':False,'logprobs':True,'top_logprobs':1,'return_token_ids':True,'add_generation_prompt':True,'chat_template_kwargs':{'thinking':False,'preserve_thinking':False}}
def response_valid(row,case):
 assert isinstance(row,dict) and row.get('model')==model and len(row['choices'])==1
 choice=row['choices'][0];message=choice['message'];ids=choice['token_ids'];prompt=row['prompt_token_ids'];usage=row['usage']
 assert message['role']=='assistant' and isinstance(message['content'],str) and not message.get('tool_calls')
 assert isinstance(ids,list) and 1<=len(ids)<=case['max_tokens'] and isinstance(prompt,list) and len(prompt)>0
 assert all(type(i) is int and 0<=i<163840 for i in ids+prompt)
 assert usage['completion_tokens']==len(ids) and usage['prompt_tokens']==len(prompt) and usage['total_tokens']==len(ids)+len(prompt)
 if case['name']=='fixed32':assert case['ignore_eos'] is True and len(ids)==32 and choice['finish_reason']=='length'
 else:assert case['ignore_eos'] is False and choice['finish_reason']=='stop' and message['content'].strip()==case['expected']
 lp=choice['logprobs'];assert isinstance(lp,dict) and isinstance(lp.get('content'),list) and lp['content']
 for token in lp['content']:
  assert isinstance(token,dict) and isinstance(token.get('token'),str) and type(token.get('logprob')) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(token['logprob']) and isinstance(token.get('top_logprobs'),list) and token['top_logprobs']
 return {'case':case['name'],'request':make_payload(case),'content':message['content'],'token_ids':ids,'prompt_token_ids':prompt,'usage':usage,'finish_reason':choice['finish_reason'],'stop_reason':choice.get('stop_reason'),'logprobs':lp}
while True:
 assert time.monotonic()<ready_deadline,'API readiness deadline'
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/health',timeout=min(5,max(.1,ready_deadline-time.monotonic()))) as r:assert r.status==200
  break
 except Exception:time.sleep(.5)
with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/models',timeout=5) as r:models=json.load(r)
assert any(item['id']==model for item in models['data'])
print(json.dumps({'event':'SF_API_READY','monotonic':time.monotonic(),'served_model':model}),flush=True)
validated=[]
for index,case in enumerate(cases):
 assert time.monotonic()<request_deadline,'API request deadline';payload=make_payload(case);began=time.monotonic();request=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions',data=json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=min(60,max(.1,request_deadline-time.monotonic()))) as r:
  assert r.status==200;raw=r.read((1<<20)+1);assert len(raw)<=1<<20
 row=json.loads(raw);print(json.dumps({'event':'SF_FIXED32_PROTOCOL_RESPONSE','index':index,'case':case['name'],'request':payload,'response':row,'seconds':time.monotonic()-began,'monotonic':time.monotonic()},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
 validated.append(response_valid(row,case))
print(json.dumps({'event':'SF_FIXED32_REFERENCE_PASS','protocol_order':[c['name'] for c in cases],'validated':validated,'monotonic':time.monotonic(),'cache_state':'UNCONTROLLED','fixed32_position':'THIRD_AFTER_TWO_BUSINESS_REQUESTS'},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
